evidence: Has the Private Broadcast label and modifies transaction announcement and relay logic in src/net_processing.cpp and src/private_broadcast.cpp.
rationale: Prevents origin privacy leaks where transactions submitted via private broadcast are inadvertently broadcast to public peers by local re-triggers such as RPC calls, wallet resends, or unbroadcast timers. Protecting privacy of transaction origin is a top priority in p2p, and this adds a comprehensive safeguard against recurring leak vectors identified across earlier PRs (#35032, #35319, #36309).
